src='''def transform(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; objs=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c] and not seen[r][c]:
                col=g[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; seen[r][c]=True; cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        na,nb=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=na<H and 0<=nb<W and not seen[na][nb] and g[na][nb]==col:
                            seen[na][nb]=True; st.append((na,nb))
                objs.append((col,cells))
    objs.sort(key=lambda o:-max(c for _,c in o[1]))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for col,cells in objs:
        best=0
        for s in range(1,W):
            ok=all(c+s<W and out[r][c+s]==0 for r,c in cells)
            if ok: best=s
            else: break
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c+best]=col
    return out
'''
